== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Forced Servitude (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_36</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 36), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-36-Forced_Servitude.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-forcedservitude-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Forced Servitude (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Your troopers are Heroic. Opponent's total weapon destiny targeting your Heroic cards is +2. When opponent is about to remove their last card from Life Force, you may first place all your troopers in Used Pile (last card must still be removed). (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1210_36</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 1 set mark, slip number 36, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
